name: brain-ops-hud
description: Code-rendered HUD, caption and disclaimer layer for BRAIN OPS episodes

scripts.still: npm run check && remotion still src/index.ts Overlay out/ep01-still.png --frame=60
scripts.render:overlay: npm run check && remotion render src/index.ts Overlay out/ep01-overlay.mov --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --pixel-format=yuva444p10le --image-format=png
scripts.render:composite: npm run check && remotion render src/index.ts Overlay out/ep01-composite.mp4
